scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana (Saubhagya)
description: The Saubhagya scheme was launched by the Ministry of Power to achieve universal household electrification across India by providing electricity connections to all willing un-electrified rural households and poor households in urban areas. Rural Electrification Corporation (REC) is the nodal agency.
eligibility: All un-electrified rural households identified via SECC 2011 data. Economically poor households in urban areas. Non-poor rural households are also eligible for connection on payment of a nominal fee of Rs 500 (recoverable in 10 installments through monthly electricity bills).
benefits: Free last-mile electricity service connection including service cable, smart/electronic electricity meter, single light point with LED bulb, and mobile charging point for all identified poor households.

For un-electrified households located in remote and inaccessible areas where grid extension is not feasible, Solar Photovoltaic (SPV) based standalone systems (including battery bank, 5 LED lights, 1 DC fan, and 1 DC power plug) are provided with 5-year repair and maintenance support.
Elimination of indoor kerosene pollution and improvement in health, education, and quality of life.
application_process: Discoms (power distribution utilities) conduct door-to-door camps in villages and wards. Beneficiaries register on the spot using mobile apps deployed by local discom officials by submitting identification proof and address.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card or Voter ID Card
provider: Ministry of Power, Government of India & Rural Electrification Corporation (REC)
source_date: Not specified on the official source.
important_conditions: The connection infrastructure and installation are subsidized/free, but ongoing monthly electricity consumption charges must be paid by the consumer according to state DISCOM tariff schedules.
Solar standalone systems are restricted to habitations where grid connection is techno-economically unfeasible.
Households with illegal connections can regularize their connections under the scheme.
